content:
I think that I have finished proving the Jacobi Sum of Four Squares formula, which is listed on the Missing theorems from Freek Wiedijk's 1000+ theorems project list on the Lean Community website under the name "Jacobi's four-square theorem". My proof is available on GitHub in my project "Sum-of-Four-Squares". The main theorem is Jacobi_sum_of_four_squares, which can be found in the file SumOfFourSquares/Formulae.lean. (It uses the definition of sum_sq_sq_sq_sq, which is defined in the same file.)

I am planning on making a Pull Request to MathLib to add it to the list of proven theorems. I wanted to check it with others before making the pull request and to see if there are particular instructions for posting results to the list.
Did you use LLMs (Aristotle, etc.) in this?
